report_summary: The report supplies strong positive examples of bounded cleanup analysis, including the DSE-specific denominator and later-written pages. It explicitly conditions claims about cheating on unknown task rules. It also uses stronger language about successful external signaling than the retained participant reports alone can certify.

section_coverage.note: Corpus, cooperation, signaling and security mechanisms.
Causal interpretation, alternatives, cleanup and evidence limits.
